## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Tarragona, Spain. It starts at Carretera de Vinyols, s/n.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Learn about the life and vision of Salvador Samà Torrens as you discover Parc Samà. Stroll through the various gardens that combine international elements to serve as a monument to 19th century romantic gardening. Discover a Mediterranean orchard, a Cuban-style garden and elements of classic British gardening.
>
> Explore the former summer residence, built in 1881 and surrounded by ponds, rare trees and impressive walkways, which is also home to a variety of animals. Observe species such as deer, pheasants or peacocks roaming freely in the park.
>
> Admire and discover more about the wonderful world of birds with a visit to the aviary. Learn about the conservation of endangered species and the scientific research to which the park is dedicated.
>
> Visit and taste the local products of Km 0 in the museum of the old oil mill farm, the vermouth museum in the old cellars created with Bodegas Yzaguirre.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €13.50. It was rated 4.4 out of 5 from 195 ratings and 111 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from
